quests.title: Woodland Encounter

dialogue.t: Huh? What's over there?
Stay away, you nasty mushrooms!
Hey, {NICKNAME}, that person over there seems to be in trouble!
We've got to help!
Oh, you were a big help! Thanks!
As you can see, I'm a Forest Watcher here. As for my name, it's Rana.

dialogue.sit: We're from a very distant place...

dialogue.t: Paimon's Paimon! We're from a different nation.
I see. Hmm... You aren't dressed like inhabitants of the forest, nor do you look like you're from the desert, but your clothes do have good breathability and are suitable for traveling in Sumeru.
Huh? Since Rana's a Forest Watcher...
Oooh! {NICKNAME}, you know Tighnari?
Tighnari may seem unapproachable, but he's actually a very nice person. He took really good care of me when I was a trainee, and his ears are gorgeous.
Yeah! Paimon really wants to touch them...

dialogue.sit: Paimon could do it super stealthily.

dialogue.t: Hmm... Paimon wonders if sneaking up on him will work...
Hahaha! Tighnari will get angry if you do it without asking first.
It probably will! But his ears are so glossy, and I can't help wondering how they feel. The girl with him seems pretty interested in them too...
Eh? Rana, are you talking about...
Huh? {NICKNAME}, you know Collei too?
Collei hasn't been very well, but she still works hard to protect the forest and eliminate The Withering. Everyone's worried about her.
Ahem! Anyway, a Forest Watcher's duty is to protect the forest, assist travelers, and provide guidance.
As the two of you might have noticed, lately the forest has been... less than ideal? The Fungi and beasts have been growing aggressive, then there's The Withering...
How about I escort both of you? My patrol route will pass through Vimara Village next. It's smooth sailing from there to either Port Ormos or Sumeru City.

dialogue.sit: Okay, but I have a few things to take care of before that...

dialogue.t: Okay, I'll keep both of you safe!
